newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Invest Bank plans public offer in '97 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Polish Invest Bank plans public offer in '97 - paper.

text.p: Poland's Invest Bank SA plans a closed issue for its current shareholders followed by a public offering this year to double its capital to about 80 million zlotys, Rzeczpospolita daily reported on Thursday.
The paper quoted Invest Bank's deputy president Bogdan Zastawny as saying that the issues were likely to be approved at the bank's shareholders' meeting in March.
According to unaudited results, Investbank, based in the western city of Poznan, netted 7.9 million zlotys in 1996 up from 4.2 million in 1995. Its balance sheet total was 768.4 million last year.
